name: Shuttle 593
description: Shuttle 593 was a Star Commuter 2000. In 4 BBY, Senator Nadea Tural of the Imperial Senate boarded the shuttle on her way to the planet Arkanis. However, the hyperdrive malfunctioned, causing the Star Commuter to crash. The senator was then rescued by the members of the rebel Spectre cell. Later the same year, the Spectres used the salvaged Shuttle 593 to make their way to Lothal without catching the attention of the Galactic Empire.
